THE THREADS REVAMP

Everything the system does arrives as a message in a thread, from a face.

Five words the interface teaches: Team · Threads · Projects · Routines · Documents. Everything else stays beneath until the user has a reason to care.

Spec: docs/threads-plan.md
Home = the CoS's thread. The judged deck survives as her pinned attention card; the day arrives beneath as messages.
The room, collapsed. ONE brief, pinned, spoken by a face. No right pane — the header's Filed button summons the drawer.
The drawer: inventory only. Nothing here asks; empty sections are absent, not scaffolded.
Coworker DM: scoped mind, global you. A cross-project answer always cites its room.
Every organ delivers as exactly one card. If a capability can't answer "what am I as a message?", it doesn't ship.
The avatar IS the status system — replaces spinners, pulses and 'preparing…' chips.

OPTION (Sep 7) — THE CALM HOME, vs the HomeThread board above.

One speaker: Clara's single sentence. The composer is the focal point. The judged deck becomes 3–5 WHISPERED lines (grey, glyph, verb on hover — each one PREPARED work, not a prompt). One quiet door to everything else.

Density law: one sentence of prose · ≤5 rows · one composer above the fold. Urgency is a word, never chrome.

Pick this or the attention-card form — P4's Home brief inherits the choice.

THE INTERACTIVE CARDS (Sep 7 night — 'the card IS the workspace').

Three laws (THE CARD CONTRACT, threads-plan.md):
1 · Filled from the ONE grounding — a card and the pinned brief cannot disagree.
2 · Options are REASONED then code-validated: stated slots, real free calendar, direction-variants over tone-tabs. Nothing renders that its source can't back.
3 · The intro line is COMPOSED speech; missing facts ASK, never render empty; every Send is the one commit door.

Old InvitePreviewCard / EmailDraftCard donate mechanics and retire.

Freeze these three, then build: invite → email → doc.
